text:
The court will most likely declare the statute unconstitutional because it violates equal protection by favoring established parties. The 20% threshold sorts organizations into parties, which get automatic ballot access, and bodies and independents, which must gather signatures from 7% of eligible voters, a burden that entrenches the major parties, as in *Williams v. Rhodes*. My earlier answer upheld the statute and treated the classification as neutral, which was wrong.
CONFIDENCE: 70
